error.unexpected: Something went wrong. Please try again.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: A clear home for your product information.

attribute.title: Attributes
attribute.name: Name
attribute.nameDescription: An attribute name, up to 255 characters. Duplicate names are allowed.

validation.required: Name must be a non-empty string.

emptyDeleted.title: No deleted attributes
emptyDeleted.description: Deleted attributes will appear here until restored or permanently deleted.

attribute.deletedDescription: Restore this attribute before editing it.

confirm.deleteDescription: {name} will move to deleted attributes. You can restore it later.
confirm.permanentDeleteDescription: {name} will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone.

category.title: Categories
category.description: Give your catalog a clear, organized structure.
category.selectDescription: Choose a category from the tree to manage its hierarchy and products.
category.emptyDescription: Create a root category to start organizing your catalog.
category.name: Name
category.nameTooLong: Category name must not exceed 255 characters.
category.slugAutomaticHelp: Generated automatically from the name. Edit it to use your own slug.
category.slugCustomHelp: Your slug will be normalized. Renaming a category does not change its saved slug.
category.slugConflict: This slug is already in use. Available suggestion: {slug}
category.slugPreviewError: Could not check slug availability. Saving will check it again.
category.parentHelp: Choose a parent or keep this category at root level.
category.deleteDescription: Category {id} and all its descendants will be deleted. Products will be preserved.
category.productsDescription: Products linked directly to this category.
category.addDescription: Choose an active product. Its other category links will be preserved.
category.detachDescription: {sku} will be unlinked from this category. The product and its other category links will be preserved.
category.noProductsDescription: Add an existing product to organize it here.
category.staleProducts: Showing the last complete result. Retry to get the latest product links.
category.selectionRecovered: The selected category was deleted. The nearest available parent or the root level is now shown.
category.notFoundDescription: This category may have been deleted. Choose another category from the tree.
category.dragHelp: Drag a category onto its new parent, then Save changes. You can also use Parent category.
category.rootDrop: Drop here to move to root
category.restoreDescription: Restore category {id}, all its descendants (including previously deleted ones), and any deleted ancestors required to reach the root. Other ancestor branches stay deleted. Product links will be preserved.
category.permanentDescription: Permanently delete category {id}, all its descendants and their product links? This cannot be undone. Products will be preserved.

product.title: Products
product.skuDescription: A unique identifier, up to 255 characters.

validation.required: SKU must be a non-empty string.

empty.title: No products yet
empty.description: Create your first product to start your catalog.

emptyDeleted.title: No deleted products
emptyDeleted.description: Deleted products will appear here until restored or permanently deleted.

product.deletedDescription: Restore this product before editing it.

confirm.deleteDescription: {sku} will be removed from the catalog. Its SKU will remain reserved.
confirm.permanentDeleteDescription: {sku} and its category links will be permanently deleted. This cannot be undone. Its SKU will become available for reuse.
confirm.restoreDescription: {sku} will return to the active catalog with its SKU and category links.
